theory: Formal evidence concerns an exact Lean statement, its environment, and audited axiom dependencies. A workspace keeps source and compiled dependency identities aligned, while final verification independently reconstructs the frozen claim. Holes, approved assumptions, stale evidence, and ambiguous declaration names remain distinct outcomes.
instead_of: A compiler wrapper could equate exit code zero with success; this package instead models what was checked and what it rests on, independently of the model thread.

absorption.rationale: Per-run assumptions, external dependency invalidation, and fresh process runners have explicit extension points that preserve exact-statement verification.

world_mapping.rationale: Frozen claims, environment identity, axiom reports, and dependency signatures express actual trust questions. Stale or ambiguous evidence cannot simply become clean grades.

abstraction.rationale: Axiom classification and scanning have shared owners, but final verification imports concrete workflow RunStore and terminal/limit contracts, retaining knowledge of run recording within the capability boundary.

justification.rationale: Comments connect absent reports, duplicated scanners, and external dependency edits to invalid evidence; verifier tests include raw strings that previously hid forbidden proof text.

honest_limits.rationale: No reports is rejection, forbidden holes cannot become approved assumptions, and final verification checks the frozen identity against the current environment.

rehearsals.requirement: Verify one run modulo named declarations without changing subsequent runs.
rehearsals.why: verify accepts a per-run allowed set; constructor values remain defaults for callers supplying none.

rehearsals.requirement: Invalidate workspace modules after shared external Lean sources change.
rehearsals.why: The external identity callback and environment rebinding feed dependency signatures.

rehearsals.requirement: Use a different bounded process runner for final verification.
rehearsals.why: Supply the ProcessSpec-to-ProcessResult runner; claim reconstruction and axiom classification remain the verifier responsibility.
